information: Home page HTML shell: title and meta description ("Watch ads, complete tasks, and earn real money with VELoop Rewards. Get instant payouts via PayPal or Paytm, no investment required."); React SPA — all content is JS-rendered, so this page alone contains no feature detail.
notes: Limitations: (1) SPA returns identical HTML for every route; (2) meta description payout methods (PayPal/Paytm) conflict with the in-app Payout UI (SRC-003); (3) marketing claims are not production statistics.

information: Official website JavaScript bundle (index-DHg8IFHw.js, ~1.26 MB): full application route map (60+ routes), Help Center navigation and content, 19 published FAQ items, legal/policy page text (disclaimer, platform currency policy, withdrawal & reward verification policy, anti-fraud policy, advertising & offerwall policy descriptions, future features notice), Payout method UI (UPI, Amazon Pay, Google Play, PayPal "Coming Soon"), Exchange Center UI, in-app trust statements.
notes: Limitations: (1) content extracted from the client-side JS bundle, not from server-rendered pages — each individual Help Center URL was not independently rendered; (2) bundle proves a feature is present in the app build, not that it is live in production for all users/regions; (3) public website source, NOT independently verified internal engineering documentation; (4) one FAQ block contains boilerplate text inconsistent with the product model (see ASM-004).

information: Payout UI section of the app bundle: available payout method cards UPI Transfer ("Instant Bank Transfer", "Processing within 24 hours"), Amazon Pay ("Gift Card Balance", "Instant delivery"), Google Play ("App Store Credit", "Global redemption"), PayPal ("Coming Soon", "Currently unavailable in your region"); "Continue Withdrawal" action routes to /Payout?method=<name>.
notes: Limitations: availability may be region-dependent ("Currently unavailable in your region" shown for PayPal); the "24 hours"/"instant" claims are UI marketing text, not measured processing performance; conflicts with home meta description (SRC-001) — see ASM-003.

information: Withdrawal & Reward Verification Policy text: eligibility and minimum withdrawal rules ("the minimum withdrawal amount is 10 INR" per the current platform model, changeable at any time); verification and review process (account-level, transaction-level, behavioral, technical, or compliance checks; review of login status, region eligibility, payout details, task-completion validity, referral validity); withdrawals may be delayed, denied, or reversed; "A submitted request does not automatically create a payout obligation."
notes: Limitations: policy text is public documentation, not an internal engineering specification; states that thresholds/methods/regions may change at any time; 10 INR is a documented current threshold, not a KPI or a measured success rate.

information: Platform Currency Policy and FAQ definitions: VEs may be used in supported redemption flows; XP supports level progression; Gems may be exchangeable into VEs where supported; Tokens may be used for platform utilities such as Gems or Spins; Spins are used for wheel-based features; all credits are virtual platform-managed units, not bank balances, stored-value instruments, or investment products.
notes: Limitations: public policy summary only; exchange rates, limits, and pairings are stated as changeable and are not itemized in the public source; no ledger or transaction model is described publicly.

information: Disclaimer text: VELOOP Rewards is "a promotional rewards and gamified engagement platform. It is not a bank, investment service, gambling platform, betting service, or financial institution."; virtual items are platform-managed credits; rewards, exchanges, withdrawals, rankings, and offers may be changed, paused, reviewed, delayed, limited, or removed at any time.
notes: Limitation: legal positioning statement; confirms the product is pre-stable and that mechanics may change, which constrains how any analytics baseline should be interpreted.

information: Published FAQ items (19): what VELOOP Rewards is; definitions of VEs/Gems/XP/Tokens/Spins; wallet system; Gems Exchange Center and Swap Center; how withdrawals work; why withdrawals can be delayed/rejected/reversed; multiple accounts/self-referrals/VPNs/bots/emulators prohibited with reward cancellation, restriction, or suspension consequences; referral rewards use "platform-defined fixed reward logic rather than a public percentage system" and only valid accepted referrals qualify; promo/giveaway codes limited by time, validity, quantity, eligibility, campaign conditions; Lucky Draw, Team Battle, Referral Milestones, Collect Cards, Surprise Rewards, Mystery Rewards are future/upcoming features; reward issues include "task validation, ad tracking delays, invalid completion"; support via tickets.
notes: Limitations: (1) individual Help Center pages were not independently rendered — content taken from the bundle; (2) the first 5 FAQ items (48h points posting, Gold/Platinum member transfers, PCI-DSS Level 1/SOC 2, card tokenization) read as generic boilerplate inconsistent with the virtual-credit product model — treated as unreliable, see ASM-004.

information: In-app trust section near Payout UI: four trust cards including "24 Hour Processing" and "Verified Transactions" (icons + labels only, no definitions).
notes: Limitation: marketing label text only; no SLA or measurement definition; not usable as a performance claim.

information: Vercel marketing landing page: described VELOOP Rewards as a rewards and engagement platform with earning modes Watch Ads, Tap & Earn, Stake & Earn, Referral, Daily Bonus, Daily Streak; VEs reward balance; redemption via UPI, Amazon Gift Card, Google Pay Gift Card, PayPal; Join → Earn → Grow → Redeem journey; all displayed figures (e.g. "+2,480 VEs this month", "1,000 VEs ≈ ₹100", "+250 VEs Daily Bonus", "+600 VEs Referral reward") explicitly labelled illustrative/UI demonstration with a footnote that final conversion, eligibility and payout terms follow VELOOP policy.
